title: 第19章 剑冢寻锋收服归字剑第20章 身陷罗网拔剑破围
slug: 欠我时间债天道也得跪着还
lines: 废弃灵矿的入口在半山腰，被一片疯长的荆棘和藤蔓遮得严严实实。
苏余用淬毒长刀砍出一条路来，刀锋掠过藤蔓的瞬间溅出一股腥臭的汁液。
矿洞深处果然如林霜所说，有残存的灵泉眼——一个约莫三尺见方的石洼，石洼底部不断地冒出一串串极细小的气泡，气泡破裂时释放出稀薄但确实存在的灵气。
苏余在灵泉眼旁边选了块平坦的岩壁，用寒霜剑凿出七个拳头大的浅坑，将七颗种子一一埋入土中。
赤阳果、碧心兰、雪玉参、墨髓花和三种无名的淡金色种子，七颗上古灵种整整齐齐排列在岩壁上，像七个沉睡的婴儿。
他捧起灵泉水浇在种子上，水滴渗入泥土时，种子表面的时间封印微微发光，然后归于平静。
林霜在矿洞深处找了一处相对干燥的角落盘膝坐下，开始每日的调息。
守宫蛊虽然安静下来了，但她体内的灵力仍然需要重新梳理。
苏余也找了个角落坐下来，把淬毒长刀和寒霜剑放在膝盖上，开始重新检查这两把武器的状态——淬毒长刀的刀刃上已出现细微缺口，寒霜剑的剑尖卷刃一直没有修复。
他需要新的武器。
时族剑冢——按照玉简地图的标注，就在黑风岭腹地最深处。
苏余决定等林霜的守宫蛊发作期过后就出发。
两天后，林霜的发作期平稳度过。
有苏余在身边，守宫蛊的发作比以往任何一次都更温和——只是灵力短暂紊乱了不到半个时辰便恢复了正常。
“走吧。”
苏余站起身来，将青铜令牌留给了林霜——守种兽虽然战力有限，但至少能挡住筑基期以下的入侵者。
林霜接过令牌，系在腰间，什么都没问。
苏余独自一人踏上了前往剑冢的路。
黑风岭腹地的地形比外围更加险恶。
古木参天蔽日，地面上厚厚一层腐叶，踩上去像踩在烂肉上。
空气中的阴气浓度明显增高，雾气从地面升腾而起，在树冠下方形成了一层灰白色的雾帐。
苏余在雾中穿行，时之共鸣像一根无形的丝线牵引着他向更深处走去。
走了一整天，他在第二天傍晚找到了剑冢的入口。
那是一座被劈开的山体。
山体裂缝高数十丈，宽不过三尺，像被一柄巨剑从山顶一剑劈到山脚。
裂缝两侧的岩壁光滑如镜，石壁上布满了剑痕——深者数尺，浅者如发丝，每一道剑痕都散发着凌厉的剑意。
即便历经万年风雨侵蚀，仍然锋锐逼人。
苏余站在裂缝前，感觉到识海中的时王碑在剧烈震颤。
那不是危险的警告，而是血脉的呼应。
他侧身挤进裂缝。
山体内部是一座天然形成的巨大溶洞。
溶洞顶部开了一道天窗，月光如银色瀑布倾泻而下，照在溶洞正中央的一片剑林之中。
数百柄飞剑密密麻麻插在青石地面上，高的直刺穹顶，低的只及膝盖。
每一柄剑的样式都不同，但所有的剑都有一个共同点——剑身上都缠绕着一层极淡的金色光芒，和他手背上的“时”字篆文如出一辙。
那是时族血脉留下的封印，数千年来无人能破。
剑林正中央立着一块高约一丈的剑碑，碑上刻着四个大字——“时族剑冢”。
碑下盘膝坐着一具白骨，白骨身穿残破的青色长袍，右手握着一柄已断裂的剑柄，左手平放在膝上，掌心朝上，掌骨中躺着一枚已经黯淡无光的玉简。
苏余走上前对白骨行了一礼，小心地从掌骨中取出玉简。
灵力激活，一道苍老的声音在识海中响起——
“时族第十六代剑修苏寒山，殁于剑冢。
吾毕生所修剑道尽刻于此碑。
后世时族子弟若有剑道天赋者，可以血祭碑，以魂试剑。
剑择主，非人选剑。
若无一剑认可，速退，不可强求。
content_en:
The entrance to the abandoned spiritual mine is halfway up the mountain, completely covered by a field of wildly growing thorns and vines.
Su Yu used the poison-quenching long knife to cut a path, and the moment the blade passed over the vines, a smelly juice splashed out.
Deep in the mine, as Lin Shuang said, there is a remaining spiritual spring eye - a stone depression about three feet square. Strings of extremely small bubbles constantly emerge from the bottom of the stone depression. When the bubbles burst, they release thin but real spiritual energy.
Su Yu chose a flat rock wall next to the Lingquan Eye, used the Frost Sword to dig out seven fist-sized shallow pits, and buried the seven seeds one by one in the soil.
Red sun fruit, blue heart orchid, snow jade ginseng, ink marrow flower and three nameless pale golden seeds, seven ancient spiritual seeds are neatly arranged on the rock wall, like seven sleeping babies.
He took the spiritual spring water and poured it on the seeds. When the water droplets seeped into the soil, the time seal on the surface of the seeds glowed slightly, and then returned to calm.
Lin Shuang found a relatively dry corner deep in the mine, sat down cross-legged, and began to adjust his breath every day.
Although Gonggong Gu has calmed down, the spiritual energy in her body still needs to be sorted out.
Su Yu also found a corner to sit down, put the poison-quenching sword and the frost sword on his knees, and began to re-check the status of the two weapons - there were slight chips on the blade of the poison-quenching sword, and the curled tip of the frost sword had not been repaired.
He needs new weapons.
Shi Clan Sword Tomb - According to the mark on the jade slip map, it is located in the deepest part of the hinterland of Black Wind Ridge.
Su Yu decided to wait until Lin Shuang's palace gecko attack period passed before setting off.
Two days later, Lin Shuang's attack period passed smoothly.
With Su Yu by his side, the attack of Gecko Gu was milder than before - it was just that the spiritual power was temporarily disturbed and returned to normal in less than half an hour.
"Let's go."
Su Yu stood up and left the bronze token with Lin Shuang - although the Seed Guard Beast has limited combat power, it can at least block intruders below the foundation building stage.
Lin Shuang took the token and tied it around his waist without asking anything.
Su Yu embarked on the road to the Sword Tomb alone.
The terrain in the hinterland of Heifeng Ridge is more dangerous than the outside.
Towering ancient trees block out the sun, and there is a thick layer of rotten leaves on the ground, which feels like stepping on rotten meat.
The concentration of yin in the air increased significantly, and fog rose from the ground, forming a gray-white fog tent under the tree canopy.
Su Yu walked through the fog, and the resonance of time was like an invisible thread pulling him deeper.
After walking all day, he found the entrance to the Sword Tomb on the evening of the second day.
It was a split mountain.
The crack in the mountain is dozens of feet high and no more than three feet wide. It looks like a giant sword has been slashed from the top of the mountain to the bottom of the mountain.
The rock walls on both sides of the crack are as smooth as mirrors, and are covered with sword marks - some as deep as several feet, some as shallow as a hair, and each sword mark exudes fierce sword intent.
Even after thousands of years of wind and rain erosion, it is still sharp and impressive.
Su Yu stood in front of the crack and felt the King of Time Monument in the sea of ​​consciousness trembling violently.
That was not a warning of danger, but a response from the blood.
He squeezed sideways into the crack.
Inside the mountain is a huge naturally formed cave.
A skylight was opened at the top of the cave, and the moonlight poured down like a silver waterfall, illuminating a forest of swords in the center of the cave.
Hundreds of flying swords were densely inserted on the bluestone ground, the high ones piercing the dome, and the low ones only reaching the knees.
The style of each sword is different, but all the swords have one thing in common - the sword is wrapped with a very faint golden light, which is exactly the same as the seal character "Shi" on the back of his hand.
That was the seal left by the Shi Clan's bloodline, and no one could break it for thousands of years.
In the center of the sword forest stands a sword stele about one foot high, with four characters engraved on it - "Shi Clan Sword Tomb".
Sitting cross-legged under the stele is a white skeleton, wearing a torn blue robe. His right hand is holding a broken sword hilt, his left hand is flat on his knees, palm facing up. There is a dull jade slip lying in the metacarpal bone.
Su Yu stepped forward and bowed to the bones, then carefully took out the jade slip from the metacarpal bone.
The spiritual power was activated, and an old voice sounded in the sea of consciousness——
"Su Hanshan, the sixteenth generation swordsman of the Shi clan, died in the sword tomb.
All the swordsmanship I have practiced throughout my life are engraved on this monument.
In future generations, if the descendants of the Shi clan are gifted with swordsmanship, they can sacrifice their blood to the monument and test the sword with their souls.
The sword chooses the master, not the sword.
If there is no approval from Yijian, retreat quickly and do not force it.
